attribution.historical: CRV stage-reference labels and AIR five-choice rank procedure only
attribution.mathematical: 5!=120; exact uniform rank distribution; top-rank1/5 and mean3
attribution.editorial: All schemas, packet separation, state machine, hashes, clocks, PNG subset, trial ledger and exclusion rules
attribution.synthetic: Deterministic seeds and procedural fixtures; not empirical or paranormal validation

canonical: Sorted-key compact JSON;ensure_ascii=false;allow_nan=false;UTF8;no terminal newline. Digests SHA256. Raw text values unchanged;no Unicode or whitespace normalization.

assignment.os_uniform: Private secrets.token_bytes one-byte draws;reject250..255;accepted byte modulo5;record all draws privately. Nonce secrets.token_hex32. OS-origin is not independently attestable from files.
assignment.simulated_seed: Only origin simulated. SHA256 UTF8(seed)+ASCII(counter),first byte;reject250..255. Nonce SHA256(UTF8(seed)+ASCII nonce). Public seeds never qualify as concealed human randomization.
assignment.manual: Explicit target ID, no uniform or chance-qualified designation;private OS nonce. Human means user-declared record origin, not verified human participation.

asset_policy: PNG only:signature,CRC,exact IHDR/one IDAT/IEND;8bit RGB,noninterlaced,filter0,correct bounded decoded byte length,no trailing bytes/no ancillary chunks. All5dimensions equal. Reject unsupported metadata-bearing files;no automatic sanitizer or semantic leak guarantee. Transfer only fresh alias.png files and packet.json;never copy source dirs/sidecars.
limits: File-owner can rewrite all history;relative hashes detect changes only against a retained independent anchor.
Clock timestamps,roles,participant separation and rights are declarations. No independently witnessed status certified.
Strict packets prevent explicit private-field export,not semantic leakage,collusion or prior knowledge.
No p-values;no empirically verified independence or ESP ability.

feedback.note: Prelock feedback accepted documentary only in training_feedback;blind_evaluation rejects and records attempt.

lock_viewer.note: Digest over exact ordered entry/feedback event records,including times,actor,text and attachment refs/hashes.

rank.note: Exactly one complete strict ranking per predeclared judge;raw report preserved.

lock_judge.note: Every predeclared judge ranks before lock;no post-reveal judge selection.

reveal.note: Exact committed preimage required;full pool/assets and previous locks revalidated.

state_policy: Accepted event times strictly increase after plan.created_at. Original strings and rejected attempts retained. Invalid action produces hashed rejected event with attempted payload and reason;state remains unchanged. Replay recomputes failure reason. A rejected command does not imply target was disclosed;any actual exposure must terminate leaked. Terminal state cannot restart.
packet_policy: Viewer packet contains only fixed neutral instructions and permitted fields;judge packet only locked transcript and all5alias-named PNG bytes/hashes. Neither contains request replay or tasker fields. Explicit optional export writes only allowed files to a previously nonexistent directory.
report_policy: Private full report includes original trial for deterministic post-reveal replay,complete attempts,locks,rights and plan. Pre-reveal public report exposes only cue,origin,state,commitment and fixed limitations;no original request or private hashes. Summary is private;requires complete fixed trial_ids ledger;records allstatuses,ranks per judge,no selected best judge. Reuse rejected or explicitly dependent;no inferential p-values. Multi-judge count is one trial.

supported: Five-candidate metadata-free PNG trials;full offline lifecycle
One or several predeclared judges,each locked separately in common judge lock
Human-declared manual/OS assignment and simulated fixed seed
experimental: Historical training-feedback documentation,always ineligible for blind scoring
unsupported: Automatic semantic leak detection or guaranteed participant blinding
